title: Aarogyasri / Telangana Health Protection pathway Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Telangana's government health assurance programme for eligible low-income and other notified beneficiary groups, covering specified hospitalization packages.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligibility depends on the current Telangana Aarogyasri beneficiary database and notified household/category rules.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Aarogyasri / Telangana Health Protection pathway.

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
